# pve_hardware_mapping_pci (Data Source)

Reads a single logical PCI hardware mapping (`GET /cluster/mapping/pci/{id}`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_hardware_mapping_pci" "gpu" {
  id = "gpu"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the logical PCI mapping to read.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the logical PCI device.
- `live_migration_capable` (Boolean) Whether the device(s) are marked as able to be live-migrated.
- `map` (Attributes List) Per-node device entries of the mapping. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--map))
- `mdev` (Boolean) Whether the device(s) are marked as capable of providing mediated devices.

<a id="nestedatt--map"></a>
### Nested Schema for `map`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the node-specific device.
- `id` (String) Expected vendor and device ID in `vendor:device` form.
- `iommugroup` (Number) The IOMMU group the device is expected in.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `path` (String) PCI path of the device.
- `subsystem_id` (String) Expected subsystem vendor and device ID in `vendor:device` form.
